run_repro_graph: run a PyTorch Inductor repro script with run, minify, analyze, or minifier-query subcommands
minify_inductor_repro: minify a failing PyTorch Inductor repro graph to isolate the root cause of compilation errors
analyze_inductor_accuracy: analyze a PyTorch Inductor repro graph for accuracy divergence between eager, compiled, and fp64 execution
wrap_compiler_debug_fn: wrap a compiler function to intercept and dump repro graphs after AOT autograd compilation
dump_compiler_checkpoint: dump a checkpoint of a compiler graph state with example inputs to disk for later debugging
isolate_failing_graph: isolate a failing PyTorch graph by running it in a subprocess and returning whether it fails
test_inductor_fails: test whether a PyTorch graph fails when compiled by Inductor with optional error string matching
